measures.item: tripod head, empty camera mount, and camera
measures.what: Read any make/model labels on the tripod/head and camera. Describe the empty mount (sliding dovetail jaws, rectangular recess with a latch, or other), whether it has a locking lever/screw and safety catch, and any plate-size markings. If possible report the camera/lens combination and approximate weight; don't measure internal camera screw-hole depth yet.
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes); camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)

measures.what: Can you confirm whether it has two dovetail jaws tightened with a screw? Measure the jaw engagement length, the opening width with jaws fully open and gently closed, and the vertical height of the angled gripping faces. Describe the jaw angle/profile, any stop pins projecting into the plate area, and any make/model markings. Say which dimensions you cannot measure; don't infer the profile just from the 38 mm plate width.
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

measures.item: salvaged webcam-mount bolt and camera base
measures.what: For the available metal 1/4-20 webcam-mount bolt, measure the usable length from under its head to its tip, head diameter and head thickness, and describe how the head is turned (slot, hex, knob). On the camera, report make/model, approximate camera+lens weight, and the width/length of the flat base around its 1/4-20 socket. If its manual gives maximum screw insertion depth, report that too. If you don't have the bolt or cannot measure something, say so.
measures.reply: webcam bolt head across: about 15 mm (its head); webcam bolt head height: about 5 mm (its head); webcam bolt length: about 10 mm (under the head); camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)

measures.item: printed clamp_fit_coupon in the tripod, and camera screw-depth specification
measures.what: With no camera attached, does the coupon sit flat, clamp firmly on BOTH angled sides before the jaw runs out of travel, and resist lifting, sliding and twisting by hand? Report yes/no/unknown for each; note any safety stop interference. Can you find the camera maker's allowed 1/4-20 screw insertion depth? If either cannot be verified, please say unknown; the finished plate must not be used to hold the camera until both are verified.
measures.reply: webcam bolt head across: about 15 mm (its head); webcam bolt head height: about 5 mm (its head); webcam bolt length: about 10 mm (under the head); tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes); camera socket thread: 1/4-20 (the usual camera thread)
